summary: T09 delete-and-tombstone implementation is correct: conditional DELETE routes through EventService, stale deletes return 412 without mutation, and durable tombstones survive event deletion. All 41 caldav_event_resource tests pass including 8 delete-specific tests. No actionable defects found.
important_context: Tombstone-before-delete ordering is required by the FK constraint (event_id REFERENCES events(id) with foreign_keys=true); the compensation path (restore_resource) handles the error case where delete fails after tombstone is written
